name: Tsukino Yuri
source:
"Next time, shall we use my new recipe? It's so good, that cumming 5 or 6 times won't be enough to satisfy us."

A high school student who is an honor student in both grades and manners, and thus she is trusted by the people around her. However, she cooks drugs in her house and sells them.

Although she manages to sell the drugs, she ended up doing it in "Kagebayashi group's turf" and the rumor of this has reached the group. She's then found by Iwamori who received the request to locate her.

However, unperturbed by Iwamori, she told him "Then how about we sell them together?", and offered him business prospects. 

Afterwards, she ends up regularly visiting Iwamori and got addicted to the pleasure of having sex while on drugs herself, so she often asks the protagonist to have sex with her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/6ninnotogime/chara5.html]Official Site[/url]]
